messages.text: we tried to order a floor standing globe to be delivered to our townhouse in Victoria Canada with a physical address . That is the truck can pull up 20 feet from our front door and they said they can t deliver to this address .(address hidden)  unit 74 . ( Not a gated community either ) ???
That sounds frustrating, especially with a clear, accessible address. To look into what happened with that order, can you give me the order number and the email it was placed under?
we abandoned the order so I dont have it in front of me now . I can try again

I don't see anything in our shipping policy that would exclude an address like yours — we ship across Canada via Purolator, Canada Post, UPS, and FedEx, and a townhouse with street access shouldn't be an issue. It sounds like something went wrong in the checkout flow itself. Let me flag this to the store owner so they can look into why it was blocked — can you give me the email you'd want them to reply to?
Handed to the team · Checkout blocked delivery to shopper's address

I've passed this to the store owner with your address and email — they'll look into why checkout blocked it and follow up with you directly, usually within a business day. In the meantime, feel free to try the order again; if it gets blocked a second time, let me know and we'll make sure it's in front of them either way.
You're welcome — sorry for the hassle, and I hope that globe finds its way to you soon. Have a great day!
